sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm back at the shop with yesterday's blue mug.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I show the shop assistant my mug.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, this mug has a crack.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sorry about that, can you show me where?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's near the handle, and the top's chipped too.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: I can see it, thanks for letting us know.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's a gift, so I haven't used it at all.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Have you got your receipt with you?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Yes, I'm here to bring it back with the receipt.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll check it for you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I read the returns sign while waiting.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says unused items need a receipt, and mine's unused.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, and you've brought everything we need.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'd like another blue mug without any damage.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Let me check what's on the shelf.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: They're fragile, so can I check the next one first?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, take your time and have a good look.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I don't want to give a broken gift.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: I understand, we'll sort this out for you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: If there's no blue one, can I get a refund?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: I'll check, then tell you the options.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The assistant comes back with news about the blue mugs.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Blue's sold out, but we've got green or a refund to your card.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, what can I get instead of blue?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: A green mug, or a refund to your card.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I see, the sign says blue mugs are sold out.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, I'm afraid we haven't got any blue ones left.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll get a refund, then, back to my card, please.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, that's eight pounds, and I'll give you a refund receipt.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, so the full eight pounds goes back to my card?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Exactly, keep this receipt until you see the money come back.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've explained the damage and checked the refund amount and method.
